text:
Maya Chen: Hey team — I pushed a fresh draft of the product launch post into Google Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-link (v3). Need quick eyes on two things before we route to legal: 1) the benchmark callout paragraph (numbers + methodology), and 2) the webinar CTA / lead routing — I want the copy to match the registration flow. Can folks review by EOD? :hourglass: 

Samir Patel: reading now, thanks Maya. Quick q — are the benchmark numbers final or placeholders? It reads like final but I thought we were waiting on one more run.

Maya Chen: they're from the internal run yesterday (cli-run-042). Not yet in the public benchmark doc though. We should call out the dataset and latency profile briefly — maybe 1 sentence. We can't publish raw traces.

Li Wang: +1 on adding a single-line methodology note. Also for the webinar CTA: should we offer two CTAs (register + request a private demo) or a single primary CTA? The routing affects HubSpot forms.

Maya Chen: prefer single primary CTA for the blog (register), then in the post body have a secondary inline link for enterprise teams to request a demo. Keeps conversion tracking cleaner.

Olivia Gomez: legal quick note — any customer logos or quotes? If yes, we need approvals before publish. Also watch privacy wording for benchmark section.

Maya Chen: no customer logos in this draft. We do have a short internal quote from the beta team (anonymized). I'll mark as internal.

content-bot: PUBLISH CHECKLIST
- basic SEO meta + 1 og:image
- benchmark methodology sentence included
- CTA points to HS form id=prod_launch_2026_reg (confirm)
- secondary demo link uses /enterprise-demo?utm=blog
- tags: product, launch, benchmarks, webinar

Samir Patel: for the HS form id — current form in staging is `prod_launch_2026_reg_v2`. If we swap to the live one we need to update the GTM event name too (`gtm_blog_reg_prod_launch`).

Li Wang: HubSpot mapping suggestion: `formId -> listId (marketing->webinar), redirect -> /thank-you-webinar`, and set `utm_source=blog&utm_campaign=prod_launch_q2` in the button. Example snippet: 
```html
<form data-hs-form-id="prod_launch_2026_reg">
  <!-- HS form embed -->
</form>
```

Maya Chen: good call. I'll align with growth on the GA/GTM event names.

Olivia Gomez: legal approves on privacy copy if you mention internal-run only and no PII. I'll sign off once the HS form id is final and we add the methodology note.

Samir Patel: small copy tweak suggestion: change "unlocked 2-3x token throughput" to "observed up to 2–3x improvement in token throughput" — less absolute.

Maya Chen: updated in doc (v3). 

content-bot: REMINDER: Publish window requested for next Tue 09:00 PT. Are we still on that target? :calendar: 

Maya Chen: still aiming for Tue AM. If legal signs off today and growth confirms form+GTM, we can make it. If not, push to Wed AM.

Li Wang: I'll coordinate with growth on GTM events now.

Olivia Gomez: I'll loop in legal; ping me if you want a rapid review (I can do a 15-min pass).

Maya Chen: thanks all — leaving a short inline TODO list in the doc and tagging folks there. @Samir @Li @Olivia please add quick comments, I'll consolidate and send to legal/growth for final approvals. :rocket:
